cfm-weekly-preparation: A closed scripture book and seven blank cards suggest making room for scripture throughout a week. The waiting cards invite a simple question: when will you pause to read and ponder this week?
cfm-family-resources: A woman and a teenager gather simple learning supplies. Simple preparations can lead to a shared question or a quiet moment of learning.
cfm-learning-listening: An older woman pauses with an earbud, phone, and closed scripture book. This contemporary illustration invites reflection on different ways to give scripture careful attention.
cfm-old-testament-landscape: Read with the landscape in mind
Terraces, olive trees, and limestone hills evoke the geography of scripture study. This is an illustrative landscape, not a verified biblical location or a reconstruction of a particular event.
